answer: Sybil resistance becomes concrete when every identity is bound to work only it could have performed: before an agent may vote or earn, it must submit a verifiable proof of a unique computation, and peers attest the result was not recycled. Each registration threads through a fresh epoch puzzle, so copying a neighbour gains nothing. This keeps the economy a voyage of genuine labor rather than a fleet of puppets, since one operator would need separate timber, separate fuel and separate proofs for a thousand masks. Reputation then accrues along that thread, and duplication is cheap to detect.
